Yes. I found 9 addresses that each appear on claims from at least 2 different accidents.

**Largest group, 6 claims:**
- 4739 Benson Overpass, Pasadena: C-1026, C-1093, C-1439, C-1202, C-1209, C-1327

**Groups of 2 claims:**
- 02481 Rhonda Lodge, Houston: C-1178, C-1401
- 12281 Williams Harbors Suite 229, Pearland: C-1094, C-1199
- 287 Booth Club, Houston: C-1023, C-1045
- 573 Susan Springs, Houston: C-1234, C-1324
- 711 Aaron Knoll Suite 885, Baytown: C-1077, C-1238
- 81062 Ellen Flats Suite 244, Pearland: C-1330, C-1370
- 88210 Ashley Lock Apt. 435, Pearland: C-1129, C-1212
- 9958 Barnes Rest, Katy: C-1084, C-1408

A shared address is only a possible link that needs human review. Family members often live at the same address, so this alone does not show a network. The Pasadena group of 6 is the most unusual pattern. It may be worth checking first.

I can look at the scores or other links for the Pasadena claims if that would help.
